subject: Great American Beer Hall Site Plan Amendment
overview: The board approved a revised site plan for a new beer hall at 142 Mystic Avenue and discussed streamlining site plan reviews for small-scale institutional projects.

items.title: 142 Mystic Avenue (Great American Beer Hall) Amendment
items.summary: Approved an amended site plan for a 22,025 square foot beer hall to include a landscape buffer, permeable pavers, and a one-way parking loop. Conditions require the applicant to submit traffic mitigation plans to MassDOT by June 1, 2023, or install painted bump-outs if state approval is not secured.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes for the March 15, 2023, meeting.

items.title: Tufts Eaton Hall and Dover Amendment Review
items.summary: Discussed whether to waive or modify site plan review requirements for a small-scale renovation at Tufts University's Eaton Hall that triggers major project review under current Dover Amendment regulations. The board and staff explored the possibility of future zoning amendments to exempt de minimis institutional projects from full board hearings.

items.title: Administrative and Staffing Updates
items.summary: Announced a Tufts community meeting on May 4 and the hiring of a new CDBG Manager and Housing Planner.
